methodologyMarkdown:
## Overview
The UN iSeek Intranet (iseek.un.org) is the United Nations Headquarters intranet portal for New York staff. Despite being labeled an intranet, the site has a substantial **public layer** accessible without authentication: 139+ UN Secretariat department pages and all PDF files hosted at iseek.un.org/sites/default/files/.

## Public Layer Structure
Entry point: https://iseek.un.org/en/nyc. Navigation via the A-Z Site Index at /en/nyc/iseek-index-un-resources lists 139+ department and office pages. Department pages contain curated lists of policy documents, procedures, memoranda, and guidance materials with direct PDF download links.

## Pass 1: PDF Harvesting
The adapter crawls the A-Z Index → dept pages → sub-pages (depth=1) and extracts all href links pointing to iseek.un.org/sites/default/files/*.pdf. These PDFs are directly downloadable without authentication. Content types: internal memoranda, guidance notes, procedures, delegation instruments, inter-agency agreements.

## Cross-References
Dept pages also contain links to undocs.org/documents.un.org (ST/SGB, ST/AI, A/RES symbols). These are extracted as cross-reference metadata (undocsRefs array) but NOT harvested as independent source documents — they are already covered by the UN Policy Portal (S3) and ODS sources. A REFERENCES edge should be created from the iSeek source document to the existing ODS document when available.

## Auth Layer
Authenticated content uses OpenID Connect (Drupal) with Microsoft Azure AD. Tenant ID: 0f9e35db-544f-4f60-bdcc-5ea416e6dc70. Login button: 'Log in with your un.org credentials'. The same tenant covers the UN Knowledge Gateway (SharePoint). A single authenticated session would unlock protected dept content and cross-portal documents.

## Limitations
- No sitemap.xml — enumeration relies on A-Z Index crawl.
- No structured date fields on public pages — document dates embedded in free-text.
- Crawl depth capped at 1 sub-level to avoid runaway crawl.
- Some dept pages redirect internally or require group membership to view sub-content.
probeNotes: Probed 2026-07-07. GET /en/nyc → HTTP 200. A-Z Index: 139 dept links. Dept pages accessible (DMSPC, OLA, OCHA, etc.). 3 PDFs verified: unitar_statute.pdf (279KB), guidelines_on_non-reimbursable_loans.pdf (274KB), cost_plan_for_grants_...pdf (1.2MB) — all HTTP 200, no auth. Login mechanism: OpenID Connect (microsoft_aad_client) → Azure AD tenant 0f9e35db-544f-4f60-bdcc-5ea416e6dc70. Same tenant as SharePoint APP-Gateway (S2).
